name: Grünstein
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated on Kaunerberg, Haus Gruenstein provides comfortable guestrooms and welcoming family hospitality. Expansive valley views invite guests to unwind in the pure alpine air.

The Kaunertal Glacier, the Kaunergrat Nature Park, and diverse walking trails are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Gruenstein in Kaunerberg offers restful mountain days and wide panoramas at the gateway to the Kaunertal.
